protocol.design: Paired fixed-budget continuation from the deployed Torch checkpoints, not from scratch.
protocol.selection: Detector checkpoint: equal-source mean validation mAP50. Classifier: equal-source mean validation macro-F1. Final detection threshold: equal-source mean typed F1 on validation only; overlap fixed at 0.4.

promotion_gate.requires: Beat both paired control and deployed baseline; pass gates on each source. Positive group-bootstrap lower bound against control. ONNX/runtime verification required separately.

limitations: One seed; cannot isolate all stochastic variation.
Top Down test has only 17 images, with no verified physical-set IDs.
No square/whole-board labels; no claim of improved whole-board accuracy.
Both source test collections have prior development exposure; regression evidence only.
75/25 source mixture is predeclared, not optimized using test results.

square_metrics.reason: No verified 64-square labels, board geometry, or square-assigned predictions.
